overclaims: Contemporary reporting documents disappointed Copilot customers
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition and outcome (historical_observation, not_applicable, unresolved) are fine. The rationale says 'disappointed Copilot customers' (plural), but e1 documents only one unnamed executive who called the tools 'gimmicky.' The e3 excerpt 'with signs it will live' stops mid-clause and drops 'up to expectations in future,' which leaves it meaningless. The e3 explanation's '132 IT leaders' and 'varied sizes' are not in the evidence text, and the search queries refer to 123. The e1 excerpt 'gimmicky.' leaves out who said it.
